text:
maria: Heads-up — ACME just confirmed they want BeamPilot in pilot next month. We need an alignment call on cross-team deps: private deploy, HSM/KMS, dedicated capacity slot, and a gated rollout. Short thread to capture decisions and owners.
chen: timeline? next month as in start of month or mid-month?
maria: they said mid-April start for a 4-week pilot.
owen: mid-April is tight. Runtime needs per-tenant quant toggle and KV-cache isolation work. Rough ETA = 3 weeks for engineering changes + 1 week for smoke.
jamal: infra: we can reserve a dedicated Dedicated pool but need commitment on GPU hours and region. Also need to coordinate prewarm policy to avoid cold-starts.
rachel: security: HSM integration + audit logs. HSM vendor requires 2 weeks for certing in our VPC image, plus KMS key policy updates. Can run in parallel with infra slotting.
maria: ok — decision points: 1) freeze MVP scope (no per-tenant quantization for pilot) 2) prioritize HSM + KMS 3) reserve 1x dedicated pool in us-west-2 for 4 weeks 4) canary rollout policy w/ automatic fallback. Thoughts?
chen: +1 to freezing per-tenant quant. We can ship without it and enable later. Saves a hard blocker.
owen: agree. With quant removed runtime surface is much smaller. We'll still need a feature-flag for the quant path so no accidental flips.
jamal: infra can reserve the slot if product signs off on GPU commit. Need final numbers: expected qps and concurrency.
maria: ACME expects ~30 qps steady, burst to 150 qps for 2–3 mins during demo windows. Concurrency per worker target = 8.
jamal: ok, reserving 4 x A40 equiv for the pilot window should cover it. Cost estimate ~ $12k for 4 weeks.
rachel: security note: HSM cert + audit logs will add ~2 days of latency to deploy during initial onboarding. We should include that in rollout gating.
chen: for rollout gating: propose this sequence — (1) infra reserve + HSM cert complete -> (2) private deploy to staging -> (3) canary to 5% enterprise -> (4) full pilot. Add an auto-fallback to hosted model if latency > SLO for 3 consecutive minutes.
owen: runtime needs a simple canary-config. Example snippet we can use in devops: 
```
canary:
  percent: 5
  fallback: hosted-compatible-model
  sla_watch:
    p95_latency_ms: 400
    window_minutes: 3
```
jamal: deploy-bot will create the capacity reservation once maria gives final signoff. (deploy-bot: reservation created draft-123)
maria: owners: product=maria, infra=jamal, runtime=owen, security=rachel, eng lead=chen. Next step: decision by EOD tomorrow on scope freeze and GPU commit. If we get that, infra will lock slots and security starts HSM certing.
chen: I'll post a one-pager with the frozen MVP scope and acceptance criteria by EOD.
owen: i'll open runtime PRs for the KV isolation and canary flag today.
rachel: I'll start onboarding with HSM vendor and request KMS policy changes.
jamal: I'll queue reservation and confirm cost center.
maria: thanks everyone. If anyone hits a blocker ping me here. :thumbsup:
